svg.aria-label: From a DNS proof to a certificate on every Gateway: 1. Token: ExternalSecret cloudflare-issuer pulls the Cloudflare DNS token from 1Password item cloudflare. 2. Request: Certificate sklab-dev-production asks ClusterIssuer letsencrypt-production for the apex and *.domain. 3. Prove: cert-manager writes an _acme-challenge TXT record in Cloudflare and checks it over DNS-over-HTTPS. 4. Sign: Let's Encrypt reads the TXT record and signs a 90-day certificate. The TXT record is removed. 5. Serve: Secret sklab-dev-production-tls feeds the HTTPS listeners of envoy-internal and envoy-external.
